Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Network.Socket.Server.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualViewSocket, VirtualView
public class SocketClientHandler extends Object implements VirtualViewSocket
Handles client socket connections and provides the needed methods for the communication between the server and a specific client.
